scripts.dev: if [ ! -f .env.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.local. See the Running locally section in README.md.' && exit 1; fi && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && if [ -n "${EB44_BOX_HOST:-}" ] && printf %s "$MONGO_URL" | grep -q '@mongo:27017'; then mkdir -p .escapebase44/dev/.cache && printf '%b\n' "$EB44_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" | tr -d '\r' > .escapebase44/dev/.cache/box_key && chmod 600 .escapebase44/dev/.cache/box_key && pkill -f '^sh .escapebase44/dev/.cache/mongo-tunnel.sh' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f '^ssh .*-L 127.0.0.1:27017:127.0.0.1:27017' 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'while :; do ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -i .escapebase44/dev/.cache/box_key -N -L 127.0.0.1:27017:127.0.0.1:27017 "$EB44_BOX_USER@$EB44_BOX_HOST"; sleep 3; done' > .escapebase44/dev/.cache/mongo-tunnel.sh && sh .escapebase44/dev/.cache/mongo-tunnel.sh & trap 'pkill -f "^sh .escapebase44/dev/.cache/mongo-tunnel.sh" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "^ssh .*-L 127.0.0.1:27017:127.0.0.1:27017" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; export MONGO_URL="$(printf %s "$MONGO_URL" | sed 's/@mongo:27017/@127.0.0.1:27017/')&directConnection=true"; fi && mkdir -p "${FRONTEND_DIR:-dist}" && [ -f "${FRONTEND_DIR:-dist}/index.html" ] || printf '%s' '<!doctype html><title>dev</title>' > "${FRONTEND_DIR:-dist}/index.html"; (uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --env-file .env.local & deno run --allow-all .escapebase44/dev/supervisor.ts & EB44_ACTORS_PORT=8004 EB44_ACTORS_DIR=base44/actors EB44_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 deno run --allow-all --unstable-worker-options --watch=base44/actors --config .escapebase44/actors-host/deno.json .escapebase44/actors-host/host.ts & vite --config vite.config.dev.ts & wait)
scripts.mobile:ios: node mobile/setup.mjs ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: node mobile/setup.mjs android && npx cap open android
